# Global Enterprise Account Executive, Workplace Equity

Full-Time  Hybrid

[Apply Now](https://partner.studysmarter.de/apply-form/?job_id=113393220&domain=us&lang=en-US&company=Trusaic&title=Global%20Enterprise%20Account%20Executive%2C%20Workplace%20Equity)

T

### At a Glance

- **Tasks:** Lead enterprise sales and drive revenue growth for our Workplace Equity SaaS products.
- **Company:** Trusaic, a global leader in regulatory compliance focused on workplace equity.
- **Benefits:** Competitive salary with uncapped commission, healthcare, 401(k), and equity opportunities.
- **Other info:** Join a diverse team dedicated to creating better workplaces for everyone.
- **Why this job:** Make a real impact by optimizing compensation strategies for global organizations.
- **Qualifications:** 8+ years in B2B SaaS sales, especially in HRTech and analytics.

Trusaic is a global regulatory compliance SaaS company focused on creating better workplaces for everyone. Our Workplace Equity platform is trusted by global organizations to optimize compensation strategies, improve transparency, and reduce risk. We partner with CHROs, Total Rewards, Compensation and HR leaders at some of the world’s most recognized brands to deliver data-driven outcomes and elevate the workplace.

Role Overview: The Global Enterprise Account Executive, Workplace Equity, is responsible for leading enterprise sales and revenue growth across international markets. This role focuses on selling Trusaic’s Workplace Equity suite of SaaS products and services to global organizations, typically with 10,000+ employees. You will develop new relationships, manage full-cycle sales engagements, and work closely with internal teams to deliver impactful solutions to CHROs, Total Rewards executives, and senior HR leaders across multiple countries and sectors.

- Own the sales process from first qualified meeting to contract close
- Engage senior stakeholders in Human Resources, Total Rewards, Compensation, and Legal
- Deliver strategic demos, presentations, and customized proposals aligned to complex client needs
- Navigate enterprise procurement, decision-making, legal review, and contract closure
- Collaborate with Customer Success to ensure seamless onboarding and long-term client satisfaction
- Manage and forecast a global pipeline using HubSpot CRM, Avoma, and ZoomInfo
- Maintain clean and up-to-date opportunity records and customer intelligence
- Report on key sales metrics and contribute to revenue and market development strategy

Qualifications:

- 8+ years in enterprise B2B SaaS sales with a focus on HRTech, Compensation, HCM, or Analytics
- Proven success managing complex sales cycles with Fortune 1000 or global organizations
- Proven success selling into CHROs, Total Rewards, Compensation, and HR leaders
- Technical aptitude and ability to work cross-functionally with product and implementation teams
- Deep understanding of global HRIS, HCM ecosystems and compensation
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills with executive presence
- Results-driven, highly organized, and skilled at strategic selling in a multi-stakeholder environment
- CRM proficiency (HubSpot preferred) and experience with prospecting platforms like ZoomInfo

Compensation:

- On-Target Earnings (OTE): $200,000–$250,000+ (uncapped commission)
- Healthcare: Medical, dental, and vision coverage
- 401(k): Eligibility after 60 days (employee contributions only)
- Paid Time Off: 15 days annually + flex holiday of your choice
- Equity: Opportunity to own shares in Trusaic and participate in the company’s growth

EEO Statement: We are an equal employment opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status or any other characteristic protected by law.

### Global Enterprise Account Executive, Workplace Equity employer: Trusaic

Trusaic is an exceptional employer that fosters a collaborative and innovative work culture, where your contributions as a Data Operations Coordinator directly influence the creation of better work environments. With comprehensive benefits including equity opportunities, healthcare coverage, and generous paid time off, Trusaic prioritizes employee well-being and growth, making it an ideal place for those seeking meaningful and rewarding careers in regulatory compliance software.

### Some tips for your application 🫡

Show Your Quantitative Skills:In the banking and financial services world, numbers are everything! Make sure your CV highlights your quantitative achievements, like high grades in finance-related courses or any certifications you've earned, such as CFA or CPA. This shows you’ve got the chops for the analytical work you'll face in this full-time role.

Tailor Your Cover Letter to Financial Services:Your cover letter should scream enthusiasm for the banking and financial services industry! Share specific experiences or projects that relate to risk management, financial analysis, or investment strategy, and express how you can bring value to Trusaic. Personalization is key here!

Use Clean, Professional Formats:When it comes to your CV, stick to a clean and professional layout. Financial firms appreciate straightforwardness, so make sure your sections are clear and your bullet points highlight relevant experiences and skills confidently. Keep it concise—no one wants to sift through a lengthy essay!

Highlight Relevant Internships or Experience:If you've had any hands-on experience in banking or finance, like internships or part-time roles, flaunt that! Detail what you learned and how those experiences prepared you for a full-time position. This shows you've got real-world understanding and are ready to jump in at Trusaic!

### How to prepare for a job interview at Trusaic

✨Master Your Financial Fundamentals

In the banking and financial services world, it's crucial to brush up on your financial concepts and terminology. Be prepared for technical questions relating to capital markets, risk management, or financial regulations. We want to see that you can hold your own in a conversation about these key topics during the interview with Trusaic.

✨Know Your Tools and Software

Familiarize yourself with the specific tools and software that are common in banking and financial services, like Excel, Bloomberg, or financial modeling software. During your interview, mentioning how you've used these tools in your studies or previous experiences will show that you're ready to hit the ground running in your full-time role.

✨Show Your Analytical Skills

Get comfy with case study problems or numerical reasoning tests that might be a part of your interview with Trusaic. This is your chance to shine by showcasing how you tackle complex data sets and make sound financial decisions—let’s use those analytical skills you've honed to impress them!

✨Communicate Your Passion for Finance

Since this is a full-time position, we want to know why you’re passionate about a long-term career in banking. Share your motivations and what drives you in the finance world. Think about what you’ve learned and how you see yourself evolving in the field—engaging stories about internships or projects will definitely resonate with interviewers.
